spielbild.webp.prompt:
Create the key art (game card image) for a children's learning game, landscape format, based on the attached screenshots of the real game. Keep exactly what the game is: the same main character (same hair, clothes, face, hearing aids if present), the same playing field and objects, the same idea and colours of the learning material. Make it look plastic and attractive: soft three-dimensional, rounded shapes, gentle light and soft shadows, a little depth of field, like a polished illustration of a premium children's app – friendly, bright, calm, never scary. Show one lively moment of play (the character in motion, e.g. mid-jump), the playing field clearly recognisable. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no user interface, no buttons, no keypad, no logos. Digits only if they are part of the learning material itself, and then few and large. IMPORTANT: this image is only shown as a small thumbnail on a game card (about 300 pixels wide). Show only very few, large, simple elements: the character big and close, a short section of the playing field, a calm plain background. Leave out small objects, background scenery, fences, plants and fine details – everything must still read at thumbnail size. Nothing important at the very edges.

This game: A girl (red curly hair, freckles, hearing aids, green overalls) hops along a hopscotch drawn in chalk on asphalt; each chalk box holds a small column of Montessori beads.

Screenshots: a.png, b.png, c.png
